case.title: 胸部后前位 X 线
case.teaching_note: 胸部常用体位教学对照。
case.description_public: Chest x-ray – posteroanterior view. Mild diaphragmatic flattening may be indicative of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Lungs clear. No pneumothorax or effusion. Heart and pulmonary vasculature
